search_tools.name: search_tools
search_tools.title: Search Tools
search_tools.description:
Search for tools using natural language.

Returns matching tool definitions ranked by relevance,
in the same format as list_tools.

query.description: Natural language query to search for tools

call_tool.description:

Use this to execute tools discovered via search_tools.

arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the tool

result.name: port_graph
result.title: Port Graph
result.description:
Render a per-port graph as an image, for example interface traffic.

Names like 'Te2/7' can fail by name behind proxies that reject or decode
the encoded slash. For 'bits' this tool then falls back to the port-group
endpoint, which renders the same traffic data by port ID, so callers
still get a graph.

ifname.description: Interface name as reported by LibreNMS, e.g. 'Po1' or 'Te2/7'

graph_type.description: Graph type: 'bits' (traffic), 'upkts' (unicast packets), 'nupkts' (non-unicast packets), 'errors', or 'etherlike'. The LibreNMS names ('port_bits', ...) are accepted too.

from_time.description: Start of the time range, either a relative offset such as '-1d', '-6h' or '-1w', or a Unix timestamp. Defaults to the LibreNMS default (-1d).

to_time.description: End of the time range, either a relative offset or a Unix timestamp. Defaults to now.

legend.description: Whether to render the graph legend.

result.name: bill_graph_data
result.title: Bill Graph Data
result.description: Get bill graph data from LibreNMS.

graph_type.description: Graph type for the current billing period: 'bits' (traffic) or 'monthly' (transfer per month)

result.name: port_group_graph
result.title: Port Group Graph
result.description:
Render a traffic graph for one or more ports, by port ID.

Plots every supplied port on the same axes, which makes it useful for
comparing members of a LAG. Unlike port_graph this takes numeric port
IDs rather than interface names.

port_ids.description: One or more port IDs to plot on a single graph. Resolve names to IDs with ports_search_field or device_ports.

from_time.description: Start of the time range, either a relative offset such as '-1d', '-6h' or '-1w', or a Unix timestamp. Defaults to the LibreNMS default (-1d).

to_time.description: End of the time range, either a relative offset or a Unix timestamp. Defaults to now.

legend.description: Whether to render the graph legend.

result.name: bill_graph
result.title: Bill Graph
result.description:
Render a bill graph as an image.

For the underlying numbers rather than a picture, use bill_graph_data.

graph_type.description: Graph type for the current billing period: 'bits' (traffic) or 'monthly' (transfer per month)

result.name: bill_history_graph_data
result.title: Bill History Graph Data
result.description: Get bill history graph data from LibreNMS.

graph_type.description: Graph type for a past billing period: 'bits' (traffic), 'day' or 'hour' (transfer per day or hour)

search_tools.name: search_tools
search_tools.title: Search Tools
search_tools.description:
Search for tools matching a regex pattern.

Returns matching tool definitions in the same format as list_tools.
Invalid, unsupported, or overlong patterns return an empty list.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive regex pattern for tool names, descriptions, and parameters, up to 1000 characters; lookarounds and backreferences are not supported

call_tool.title: Call Tool
call_tool.description:
Call a tool by name with the given arguments.

Use this to execute tools discovered via search_tools.

name.description: The name of the tool to call

arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the tool
